what_it_shows: Terminated tenants (20 of 61, terminated 2025-08 to 2026-07): 20 of 20 still hold attachments. Error events (200): 23 contained email addresses or ticket text. Warehouse saved queries (10 of 120): 3 used subject-line text. Laptop wipe certificates (10 of 31): on file for all 10

title: Gap analysis samples: operations
source_system: Security incident queue; questionnaire log; bug bounty platform; scanning service
what_it_shows: Incidents (10 of 44): discovery and confirmation times recorded in 10 of 10; 2 required customer notice, both sent within 48 hours to customers with contacts on file. Questionnaires (10 of 212 completed in 2026): 3 said all staff access is logged and 2 said DR is tested within 4 hours. Bug bounty reports (10 of 47): all triaged within 3 business days. Critical image findings closed 2026-02 to 2026-07 (all 38): median 41 days, 29 of 38 over 15 days

title: Gap analysis contract review
source_system: Legal contract database
what_it_shows: DPAs (14 of 14) reviewed; BAAs with covered entities (46 of 46) signed; contracts of the 6 sub-processors that receive healthcare cell data reviewed, 4 with subcontractor BAAs; sub-processor additions in the last 12 months (2: translation API 2026-02, status page provider 2025-11) each noticed 30 or more days ahead; contracts with 9 of 9 banks name a point of contact, and the IR plan has no procedure or trigger for the bank notice

title: Control assessment: account management
source_system: Identity provider and HR exports; quarterly review records; samples of 25 of 96 terminations, 25 of 58 transfers and 25 of 141 new accounts; source hosting member export; Director of IT interview
what_it_shows: Terminations: 2 of 25 disabled 3 and 5 days after the last day because HR entered the termination late, and account managers were not told on time. Transfers: 4 of 25 kept roles from the prior team for more than 30 days. The Q3 2025 data analytics review was not performed. Source hosting member export (2026-08-26): 2 former contractors' local accounts outside single sign-on, removed 2026-09-02

title: Control assessment: tenant isolation
source_system: Authorization middleware design; code review of 12 of about 140 data access paths; search cluster configuration; May 2026 bug bounty report
what_it_shows: All 12 sampled data access paths enforce tenant ID in application code; the search cluster uses one shared credential for all tenants; no second layer (database or service credential) and no automated cross-tenant test; one link-sharing flaw reported by a researcher in May 2026

title: Control assessment: least privilege
source_system: Permission set and role exports for all 10 core accounts; key inventory; warehouse role export
what_it_shows: 14 standing administrator roles in the data analytics and legacy accounts; the warehouse loader key can read every Standard and Enterprise attachment although it needs only metadata; 140 employees can query ticket metadata in the warehouse

title: Control assessment: privileged accounts
source_system: Root credential register; break-glass test record 2025-11; root MFA settings for 10 core accounts
what_it_shows: Root and break-glass accounts restricted to 2 named administrators; 3 of 10 root accounts use software MFA; the break-glass procedure was not tested in 2026

title: Control assessment: logging of privileged functions
source_system: Just-in-time session logs; database audit settings; support view audit log
what_it_shows: Just-in-time elevation and support view sessions are logged; SQL statements run by engineers during elevated database sessions are not logged, so privileged data access cannot be traced to a record

title: Control assessment: event logging
source_system: Logging configuration for all accounts; SIEM source list; Director of Security and detection engineer interviews
what_it_shows: Logged event types do not include object-level reads of attachments or database query activity in any customer data store, including the healthcare cell; no documented rationale for the selected events; event types not reviewed since 2024, including at the healthcare cell launch in November 2025

title: Control assessment: audit record review
source_system: SIEM rule list and alert queue (July 2026); support view audit log; MDR monthly reports; simulated bulk download test 2026-08-26
what_it_shows: Support view sessions are not reviewed; a simulated bulk download of 2,000 test attachments with a test key on 2026-08-26 produced no alert; review was not adjusted when the healthcare cell launched or the AI features went live

title: Control assessment: audit record retention
source_system: Retention settings for the log archive, logging SaaS and SIEM
what_it_shows: Cloud audit logs kept 1 year; application logs kept 30 days; no retention period defined for HIPAA-required records (6 years under 45 CFR 164.316(b)(2)(i))

title: Control assessment: audit record generation
source_system: Trail configuration for all accounts; healthcare cell storage settings
what_it_shows: Control-plane audit records generated in every account; data event records not generated for attachment storage or databases in production or the healthcare cell

title: Control assessment: penetration testing
source_system: Penetration test report (March 2026); statement of work; bug bounty program page
what_it_shows: Annual external penetration test of the platform and API in March 2026 by an independent firm; the public bug bounty runs continuously

title: Control assessment: change control
source_system: Change records; deployment log; samples of 25 of about 7,800 standard changes and 25 of 61 emergency changes (2026-01 to 2026-06)
what_it_shows: 25 of 25 standard changes reviewed and approved; 2 of 25 emergency changes deployed with no review, approval or security impact consideration before or after deployment; no after-the-fact review or report of emergency changes

title: Control assessment: configuration settings
source_system: Guardrail policies; benchmark scans of container images and 10 sampled cloud resources; search cluster configuration
what_it_shows: Guardrails enforced in every account; no documented secure configuration for the search cluster virtual machines and the 2 legacy accounts (STD-01 in draft); deviations in 4 of 10 sampled hand-built legacy resources not identified or documented

title: Control assessment: component inventory
source_system: Cloud asset inventory export; sandbox account list; SaaS integration list
what_it_shows: The 22 sandbox accounts and 6 SaaS integrations that receive customer data are not in the inventory; owner and data classification tags missing on 31% of production resources

title: Control assessment: contingency plan
source_system: In-region restore runbooks; draft regional DR plan; P05 BIA; VP Platform Engineering and Director of Security interviews
what_it_shows: The regional DR plan is an unreviewed, unapproved draft that has not been distributed; it lacks current contacts for the cloud provider's escalation and 2 sub-processors, emergency mode operation for the healthcare cell and full restoration after a regional loss; problems and lessons from the February 2026 test (search rebuild, manual DNS steps) are not in it; no process to communicate plan changes

title: Control assessment: contingency plan testing
source_system: DR test report 2026-02; test plan; interviews
what_it_shows: Regional failover tested once (February 2026); only 3 engineers can run the failover and runbooks are not current; no corrective action plan was opened after the test missed its 4-hour objective until this assessment

title: Control assessment: system backup
source_system: Backup policy; snapshot inventory; backup job report August 2026 (31 of 31 days); restore of one database shard to a test account observed 2026-08-27
what_it_shows: 31 of 31 daily backups in August 2026 succeeded; the observed restore of one database shard completed in 52 minutes; backups in the DR account are not write-once and can be deleted by the administrator roles that manage production

title: Control assessment: recovery and reconstitution
source_system: DR test report 2026-02; P05 RTOs
what_it_shows: Recovery after a regional disruption took 9 hours against the 1-hour RTO for core processes and the 4-hour MTD; full reconstitution needs a search index rebuild of about 20 hours

title: Control assessment: MFA for privileged accounts
source_system: Sign-in tests on 25 of 210 privileged accounts
what_it_shows: 25 of 25 privileged sign-ins required a phishing-resistant security key

title: Control assessment: authenticator management
source_system: Key inventory (all 9 long-lived keys); CI variable listing; identity provider password policy; third-party API key register
what_it_shows: 4 of 9 long-lived cloud access keys older than 1 year, none with a rotation schedule; the 9 keys stored as CI variables and in one contractor job configuration instead of the secrets manager; shared third-party API keys (SMS, email, model provider) not changed after 2 of 3 sampled engineer departures

title: Control assessment: embedded authenticators
source_system: Contractor extract job configuration; repository secret scanning history
what_it_shows: One contractor-managed job configuration file held a long-lived cloud access key in plain text; secret scanning did not cover the contractor's repository; the key was rotated the same day

title: Control assessment: incident handling
source_system: IR plan 2025; incident log; sample of 10 of 44 incidents; tabletop report 2025-11
what_it_shows: The 10 sampled incidents were handled and recorded consistently; security contacts missing for 29% of customers and no customer notice templates; no outage runbook or link to contingency planning before P08; 3 of 5 actions from the November 2025 tabletop not in the procedures

title: Control assessment: incident reporting
source_system: POL-03 2023 version; interviews with 15 randomly selected staff; BAA and bank contract registers
what_it_shows: 15 of 15 staff knew how to report a suspected incident; required recipients not defined for covered entities (BAA), bank customers (4-hour notice) or 24-hour Enterprise customers

title: Control assessment: incident response plan
source_system: IR plan 2025 (the version in force during fieldwork); distribution records
what_it_shows: The 2025 plan sets structure, roles and resources and is distributed; it does not include the bank 4-hour notice, the BAA 10-business-day notice or the 24-hour Enterprise terms, does not define which incidents are reported to covered entities, has no metrics, and was not updated for the healthcare cell launch or the AI features

title: Control assessment: personnel termination
source_system: Termination sample (25 of 96); third-party API key register
what_it_shows: 2 of 25 sampled terminations disabled 3 and 5 days late against the 4-hour standard; shared third-party API keys known to departing engineers not revoked

title: Control assessment: authority to process
source_system: DPA and BAA templates; trust center capture 2026-07-20; data map; warehouse queries (10 of 120 saved queries); AI endpoint configuration
what_it_shows: Authority to process documented in the DPA and BAAs; 3 of 10 sampled warehouse queries use ticket subject-line text, including healthcare cell rows; the model provider keeps Standard tenants' prompts for 30 days

title: Control assessment: risk assessment
source_system: P01 risk register; prior 2025 risk list; healthcare cell launch records
what_it_shows: Enterprise risk assessment completed 2026-08-07; the risk assessment was not updated when the healthcare cell launched (November 2025) or when the warehouse feed was added

title: Control assessment: vulnerability monitoring
source_system: Scanner configuration; all 38 critical findings closed 2026-02 to 2026-07; penetration test findings
what_it_shows: 29 of 38 critical image findings exceeded the 15-day target (median 41 days); the High SSRF penetration test finding open since March 2026

title: Control assessment: use of live data
source_system: Staging and development data sources; snapshot sharing guardrail; snapshot share attempt 2026-08-25
what_it_shows: Staging and development use synthetic data since 2025; the guardrail blocked a test attempt to share a production snapshot

title: Control assessment: external system services
source_system: Contract register; DPAs (14 of 14); subcontractor BAAs; vendor review files; AI provider endpoint terms
what_it_shows: The SMS provider and error-tracking SaaS receive healthcare cell data with no subcontractor BAA; the model provider keeps prompts 30 days on the standard endpoint; annual monitoring overdue for 5 of 14 sub-processors

title: Control assessment: developer testing
source_system: SDLC standard; CI pipeline definitions; AI feature release records; penetration test tracker
what_it_shows: No privacy assessment plan or privacy assessment for AI Assist or Answer Bot before release; testing does not cover cross-tenant authorization or prompt injection in depth; the March 2026 SSRF flaw is not corrected

title: Control assessment: boundary protection
source_system: Network diagrams; firewall rules; route tables; egress allow lists; flow logs for the healthcare account
what_it_shows: Ingress only through the edge and no routes between accounts; egress from the healthcare cell allows the SMS provider and error-tracking SaaS (no BAA) and the nightly warehouse export, without content controls

title: Control assessment: protection of information at rest
source_system: Encryption settings for 9 data stores; device management report; 30 of 640 laptops checked
what_it_shows: 9 of 9 data stores encrypted with company-managed keys; 30 of 30 sampled laptops encrypted

title: Control assessment: flaw remediation
source_system: Patch reports; all 38 critical findings; SSRF ticket
what_it_shows: Security updates for critical findings installed in a median 41 days against the 15-day standard; the SSRF flaw identified in March 2026 not corrected; firmware is inherited from the cloud provider

title: Control assessment: system monitoring
source_system: SIEM and MDR scope; threat detection settings; simulated bulk download 2026-08-26; legal opinion on monitoring (2024)
what_it_shows: Cloud workloads outside the MDR provider's scope; no data-plane monitoring in customer data stores; the simulated bulk download was not detected; monitoring was not increased when the healthcare cell launched

title: Control assessment: information retention
source_system: Deletion job design; 20 of 61 terminated tenants; 200 error-log events; retention settings
what_it_shows: 20 of 20 sampled terminated tenants still hold attachments beyond the 30-day commitment; 23 of 200 sampled error events sent to the error-tracking SaaS contained email addresses or ticket text

title: Control assessment: supplier assessments
source_system: Vendor review files; contractor agreement
what_it_shows: Annual supplier reviews overdue for 5 of 14 sub-processors; contractor personnel not screened under the DOJ Data Security Program
